name: town-negative
description: The negative baseline for the town inventory redesign (borg-zoo#81): borg-rs with no store interaction at all, against the same build trading normally, both arms with every mode pinned off. A calibration floor, not a candidate strategy: the arm is expected to be worse and no improvement is claimed in either direction. Prespecified, per class and paired on the seed: character level at 50% and 100% of the cap (milestones[].level) and final.max_depth; secondary: milestones[].gold (must not move), first_turn_at_depth, final.keys, the death split. classes-18 is the pilot (36 cells); the full grid (classes-1800) follows only if the pilot reads well.
